evidence: Modifies descriptor parsing and wallet import/funding logic (src/script/descriptor.cpp, src/wallet/imports.cpp, src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp) to prevent key leakage.
rationale: Stops raw WIF private keys and xprv substrings from being reflected in wallet error responses when descriptor parsing or derivation fails. Protecting secret keys from leaking into application logs or shared diagnostics directly impacts wallet key safety.
